info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Product Details API
info.description: The Loan Product Details API provides access to specific information regarding various loan products offered by the organization. By utilizing this API, users can retrieve detailed data about loan products, including terms, rates, and eligibility criteria. It is primarily intended for financial institutions and developers looking to integrate loan product information into their applications or services. This API serves as a crucial resource for enhancing customer decision-making and ensuring that users have access to the most relevant loan options.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific loan product.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a particular loan product identified by its unique ID, providing insights into its features, terms, and conditions.
